contexts.text: Their descendants... inhered with the mind (in worldly and earthly things).
The man of the Most Ancient Church... would not have inhered at all in the sense of the letter.
Whatever does not enter by some delight... does not inhere...
Without such insertion heres... nothing inheres...
When a man comes into evil thus, it inheres...
For compulsory faith... does not inhere. HH 293:end.
When they think from their own understanding, they do not inhere in these things...
For natural light does not inhere; but departs with the sun.
This proprium inheres in the Angels from their birth as men.
The things of the flesh... inhere from birth.
Holy Spirit. 4. 4. The Holy meant by the Holy Spirit does not inhere, nor remain, except in so far as the man who accepts it... is in doctrine... and a life according to it.
